# GamedevJelly: full index

> Hand-filtered Unity library. Newest guides per topic, then repos, assets and books. Complete data: https://bartouv.github.io/gamedevjelly/data/library.json


## Shaders & rendering


### Shader basics & recipes (19 guides; slug `shader-basics`)
- [Understanding Unity shader structure](https://jettelly.com/blog/understanding-unity-shader-structure): Quick look at what goes into a Unity shader: ShaderLab, HLSL and related pieces. (Jettelly, 2026-08-21, article, Unity-6 era)
- [Custom Shader FX Nodes - No Boilerplate](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uFYLIdYXntk): Discover Unity 6.5’s powerful new Shader Function Reflection API. Write normal HLSL functions, add minimal boilerplate, and Unity automatically turns them into fully-featured Shader Graph nodes with p (git-amend, 2026-06-21, video, Unity-6 era)
- [Unity Shader Code Basics 01 - Your First Shader](https://danielilett.com/2025-10-15-tut10-01-your-first-shader/): Introduces writing HLSL shader code in Unity, where Shader Graph falls short. (Daniel Ilett, 2025-10-15, article, Unity-6 era)
- [@halisavakis.com: HLSL function declared in one file, defined in another](https://bsky.app/profile/halisavakis.com/post/3lyhyn55eyc2l): Shader tip: split declaration and definition across include files so passes share code while implementations vary. (Harry Alisavakis, 2025-09-10, post, Unity-6 era)
- [Unity Shader Graph Basics (Part 10 - Custom Functions)](https://danielilett.com/2024-07-09-tut7-14-intro-to-shader-graph-part-10/): Injects custom HLSL functions into Shader Graph, including access to additional point light data. (Daniel Ilett, 2024-07-09, article, Unity-2022 era)
- [Unity Shader Graph Basics (Part 9 - Scene Intersections 2)](https://danielilett.com/2024-05-28-tut7-13-intro-to-shader-graph-part-9/): Uses scene intersections for foamy coastal water edges and glowing edges on passing objects. (Daniel Ilett, 2024-05-28, article, Unity-2022 era)
- [New Shader Graph feature examples in 2022 LTS](https://unity.com/blog/engine-platform/shader-graph-feature-examples-2022-lts): Sample set of Shader Graph feature examples you can import to learn many effects and techniques. (Unity, 2024-03-19, article, Unity-2022 era)
- [Unity Shader Graph Basics (Part 3 - Transparency & Alpha)](https://danielilett.com/2023-12-11-tut7-5-intro-to-shader-graph-part-3/): Explains transparency, draw order and alpha clipping in Shader Graph. (Daniel Ilett, 2023-12-11, article, Unity-2022 era)
- [Unity Shader Graph Basics (Part 1 - Your First Graph)](https://danielilett.com/2023-09-26-tut7-3-intro-to-shader-graph/): Beginner guide to creating your first Shader Graph shader in Unity. (Daniel Ilett, 2023-09-26, article, Unity-2022 era)
- [Just a moment...](https://www.patreon.com/posts/shader-graph-for-81985104): Patreon post on building an effect in Shader Graph. (2023-04-26, post, Unity-2022 era)

## Environment


### Water, waves & ripples (64 guides; slug `water`)
- [Barely Breathing: procedural puddles that follow the environment](https://jettelly.com/blog/barely-breathing-a-new-procedural-puddle-generator): Updated procedural puddle generator that spreads around obstacles and follows environment shape. (Jettelly, 2026-09-12, article, Unity-6 era)

- [Generating a Living Sea](https://bartouv.github.io/articles/generating-a-living-sea.html): The three systems behind a Privateer battle are really one pipeline: wave function collapse builds an island map, the jump flood algorithm turns its coast into a distance field, and the boids fish read that field to stay in the water. (Gal Bartouv, 2026-07-01, article, Unity-6 era)
- [Charting a New Sea Every Run](https://bartouv.github.io/articles/charting-a-new-sea-every-run.html): How the run map is generated: Poisson disc scatter for even beacons, Delaunay triangulation for natural links, then pruning and connectivity guarantees so an FTL-style sea is always playable start to boss. (Gal Bartouv, 2026-07-01, article, Unity-6 era)
- [Every Pixel Knows Its Nearest Shore](https://bartouv.github.io/articles/jump-flooding-the-shoreline.html): The jump flood algorithm builds a distance field to the coastline in a handful of GPU passes, and one field drives shore foam, shallow water, and fog of war. How JFA works and how to stop it flickering. (Gal Bartouv, 2026-07-01, article, Unity-6 era)
- [Simulating surf breaks in Unity with bathymetry depth maps](https://jettelly.com/blog/simulating-surf-breaks-in-unity-with-bathymetry-depthmaps): Wave system behind a surfing game, driven by bathymetry depth maps. (Jettelly, 2026-06-24, article, Unity-6 era)
- [Stylized Water 2026](https://www.patreon.com/minionsart/posts/stylized-water-160525474): Patreon post on a 2026 update to a stylized water shader. (MinionsArt, 2026-06-01, post, Unity-6 era)

## Repos
- [UniTask](https://github.com/Cysharp/UniTask) (Async & reactive, ★11245, last push 2026-10-06): You want async/await in Unity without allocations, with PlayerLoop-aware delays and cancellation. Install: https://github.com/Cysharp/UniTask.git?path=src/UniTask/Assets/Plugins/UniTask
- [R3](https://github.com/Cysharp/R3) (Async & reactive, ★4018, last push 2026-10-08, Unity 7: workaround): You want Rx-style reactive streams; the successor to UniRx.
- [MessagePipe](https://github.com/Cysharp/MessagePipe) (Async & reactive, ★2002, last push 2026-10-07): You need an in-process pub/sub or mediator that works with DI containers.
- [ZString](https://github.com/Cysharp/ZString) (Serialization & data, ★2815, last push 2026-10-07): You build strings every frame and want zero allocations.
- [MemoryPack](https://github.com/Cysharp/MemoryPack) (Serialization & data, ★4753, last push 2026-10-07): You need very fast binary serialization for save data or networking.
- [MessagePack-CSharp](https://github.com/MessagePack-CSharp/MessagePack-CSharp) (Serialization & data, ★6788, last push 2026-10-12): You want compact, fast MessagePack serialization with Unity (IL2CPP) support.
- [MagicOnion](https://github.com/Cysharp/MagicOnion) (Networking & backend, ★4454, last push 2026-10-07): You want type-safe RPC between a Unity client and a C# server.
- [VContainer](https://github.com/hadashiA/VContainer) (Dependency injection, ★3072, last push 2026-10-06): You want a fast, lightweight DI container with low GC pressure. Install: https://github.com/hadashiA/VContainer.git?path=VContainer/Assets/VContainer
- [Reflex](https://github.com/gustavopsantos/Reflex) (Dependency injection, ★1634, last push 2026-10-10, Unity 7: ok): You want a minimal DI container with a small API.

- [LinqGen](https://github.com/cathei/LinqGen) (C# & performance, ★316, last push 2024-07-07): You want LINQ-style queries without allocations, using code generation. Install: https://github.com/cathei/LinqGen.git?path=LinqGen.Unity/Packages/com.cathei.linqgen

- [Data-Oriented Design (Claude skill)](https://github.com/Data-Oriented-Design-for-Games/data-oriented-design) (AI & agents, ★8, last push 2026-07-21): You want Claude to apply data-oriented design to your game code, following Nitzan Wilnai's book.

## Books
- [Unity 6 Shaders and Effects Cookbook](https://www.packtpub.com/product/unity-6-shaders-and-effects-cookbook-9781835468579) by John P. Doran (Packt, 2025, Intermediate): You want recipe-style Shader Graph and visual effects examples written for Unity 6.
- [Building Quality Shaders for Unity](https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-1-4842-8652-4) by Daniel Ilett (Apress, 2022, Beginner to intermediate): You want a structured path from HLSL shader code to Shader Graph, across the built-in, URP and HDRP pipelines.
- [Beginner's Guide to Unity Shader Graph](https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-1-4842-9672-1) by Álvaro Alda (Apress, 2023, Beginner): You are new to shaders and want twelve worked Shader Graph effects, from scan lines to water.
- [Unity 6 Game Development with C# Scripting](https://www.packtpub.com/product/unity-6-game-development-with-c-scripting-9781835880401) by Lem Apperson (Packt, 2025, Beginner to intermediate): You want to learn Unity scripting in C# by building complete game projects.
- [Learning C# by Developing Games with Unity 6](https://www.oreilly.com/library/view/-/9781805808718/) by Harrison Ferrone (Packt, 2025, Beginner): You are new to C# and want to learn it while building a first-person prototype.
- [Create popular shaders and visual effects with the Universal Render Pipeline](https://unity.com/resources/create-shaders-visual-effects-urp-unity-6) by Unity (free, Intermediate): Toon and outline shaders in Shader Graph, plus X-ray style effects with stencils.
- [Introduction to the Universal Render Pipeline for advanced Unity creators](https://unity.com/resources/introduction-to-urp-advanced-creators-unity-6) by Unity (free, Advanced): Setting up URP, quality settings, Adaptive Probe Volumes and custom HLSL shaders.
- [The definitive guide to creating advanced visual effects in Unity](https://unity.com/resources/creating-advanced-vfx-unity6) by Unity (free, Advanced): Building real-time effects with the VFX Graph and its related tools.
- [UI Toolkit for advanced Unity developers](https://unity.com/resources/scalable-performant-ui-uitoolkit-unity-6) by Unity (free, Advanced): Scalable, performant UI with examples from the official UI Toolkit samples.
- [Introduction to DOTS for advanced Unity developers](https://unity.com/resources/introduction-to-dots-ebook) by Unity (free, Advanced): Data-oriented programming, and how to tell whether DOTS suits your project.
- [Create modular game architecture in Unity with ScriptableObjects](https://unity.com/resources/create-modular-game-architecture-with-scriptable-objects-ebook) by Unity (free, Intermediate): Structuring a project with ScriptableObjects, with a companion demo project.
- [Level up your code with design patterns and SOLID](https://unity.com/resources/design-patterns-solid-ebook) by Unity (free, Intermediate): SOLID principles and common game patterns such as Factory, Observer, Singleton and Object Pooling, with a sample project.
- [Use a C# style guide for clean and scalable game code](https://unity.com/resources/c-sharp-style-guide-unity-6) by Unity (free, Beginner to intermediate): Naming, formatting and commenting conventions for a shared Unity codebase.
- [The ultimate guide to multiplayer networking for advanced Unity developers](https://unity.com/resources/ultimate-guide-advanced-multiplayer-networking) by Unity (free, Advanced): Core multiplayer concepts and networking models, with an example using Netcode for GameObjects.
- [Optimize your game performance for mobile, XR, and Web in Unity](https://unity.com/resources/mobile-xr-web-game-performance-optimization-unity-6) by Unity (free, Advanced): Performance tips for mobile, XR and Unity Web projects.
- [Optimize your game performance for consoles and PCs in Unity](https://unity.com/resources/console-pc-game-performance-optimization-unity-6) by Unity (free, Advanced): Performance tips for PC and console projects.
- [Ultimate guide to profiling Unity games](https://unity.com/resources/ultimate-guide-to-profiling-unity-games) by Unity (free, Intermediate): Profiling workflows, memory management and power optimization with Unity's tools.
- [Best practices for project organization and version control](https://unity.com/resources/best-practices-version-control-unity-6) by Unity (free, Intermediate): Version control concepts, a comparison of common systems and Unity's DevOps tools.
- [Game Programming Patterns](https://gameprogrammingpatterns.com/) by Robert Nystrom (free, 2014, Intermediate): You want the patterns behind game code (state machines, observers, object pools, game loops) explained with clear examples. Free to read online.
- [Game Engine Architecture, Third Edition](https://oreilly.com/library/view/game-engine-architecture/9781351974271) by Jason Gregory (CRC Press, 2018, Intermediate to advanced): You want to understand how a whole engine fits together: memory, rendering, animation, physics, concurrency. Written by a Naughty Dog engineer.
- [Game Coding Complete, Fourth Edition](https://www.cengage.com/c/game-coding-complete-4e-mcshaffry/9781133776574/) by Mike McShaffry and David Graham (Cengage, 2012, Intermediate): You want a start-to-finish tour of what goes into shipping a game: architecture, resources, input, audio, AI, debugging.
- [Learning Design Patterns with Unity](https://www.oreilly.com/library/view/learning-design-patterns/9781805120285) by Harrison Ferrone (Packt, 2024, Intermediate to advanced): You want to apply Singleton, Observer, Factory, Visitor, Decorator and other patterns in Unity projects without over-engineering.
- [Unity Game Optimization, Third Edition](https://www.oreilly.com/library/view/-/9781838556518) by Davide Aversa and Chris Dickinson (Packt, 2019, Intermediate to advanced): You want a systematic guide to finding and fixing performance problems in scripting, rendering, memory and physics.
- [High Performance Unity Game Development](https://manning.com/books/high-performance-unity-game-development) by Nitzan Wilnai (Manning, 2026, Intermediate to advanced): You want to architect a Unity game around data-oriented design for high frame rates without relying on an ECS framework.
